name: Politecnico di Milano
summary: Milan's technical university for engineering, architecture and design; six English bachelor's across Milan, Lecco, Piacenza and Cremona.

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts if you entered the IB after promotion to your penultimate school year. A diploma taught in English meets the English rule; every degree ranks you on an entrance test.

programmes.name: Architectural Design (English track)
programmes.about: Designing architecture at every scale, from history, representation and maths to building technology and conservation, in design studios; English tracks in Milan and Piacenza.
programmes.ib: National ARCHED test in English; 2026: register 17 June–16 July, test 23 July. English tracks: Milano Leonardo (50 EU places) and Piacenza (10).
programmes.selectionNote: Places go by ARCHED test score and your stated preferences. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: register 17 June–16 July; ARCHED test 23 July

programmes.name: Civil Engineering (English track)
programmes.about: Planning, design, construction and upkeep of structures and infrastructure such as bridges, tunnels, dams, water systems and transport networks, on a base of maths and physics.
programmes.ib: Ranked on an entrance test: the TOL (in Italian), or CEnT-S (in English) or the SAT instead.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score, with a separate ranking for the English-taught programmes. 2026 criteria; 2027 details due around January 2027.

lastYear.text: TOL 1 Feb–31 May; CEnT-S or SAT in by 4 June

programmes.name: Engineering Science
programmes.about: A broad engineering degree: a common core of maths, physics, chemistry, materials and computing, then you gradually choose a field instead of committing on day one.
programmes.ib: Ranked on an entrance test: the TOL (in Italian), or CEnT-S (in English) or the SAT instead.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering
programmes.about: Manufacturing, automation, logistics and digital innovation, taught in three terms a year with labs, projects and industrial partners on the Piacenza campus.
programmes.ib: Ranked on an entrance test: the TOL (in Italian), or CEnT-S (in English) or the SAT instead.

programmes.name: Process Engineering
programmes.about: Designing and optimising industrial processes that turn raw materials into chemicals, energy, food and medicines, with automation, data analytics, AI and digital twins.
programmes.ib: Ranked on an entrance test: the TOL (in Italian), or CEnT-S (in English) or the SAT instead.

programmes.name: Interaction Design
programmes.about: Designing apps, websites, smart devices and IoT systems that mix digital and physical parts, with user research, prototyping and programming, in Lecco.
programmes.ib: Design entrance test (TOLD) sat in English, in person in Italy, once only; 2026 window 14 March–14 May.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your TOLD score. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The 2027-28 admission rules are not out yet: Polimi says more information will come around January 2027, so the dates shown are 2026's.
You need no Italian to start an English-taught degree, but you must reach Italian B2 before you graduate.
MEDTEC School, also listed as English-taught, is a six-year medicine and biomedical engineering degree run with Humanitas University and is not listed here.
